title: findSummaries request
description: GET /v1/summaries - request. Current summaries for one SummaryKey (templateId, from, to, locale): at most one per SummaryKind.
$comment: Source: DISENO S2 (d) SummaryQuery, (e), (i) Redis cache-aside, AP-S1 summary_current; DISENO 4.8 SX-01b; ADR-020 SX-01b; PRD RF-041, RF-042, RF-050. Audience: INTERNAL service-to-service - SX-01b callee. Residency: GLOBAL (home region); TEMPLATE_PUBLIC content only, may be read cross-region; requests and responses never carry engagementId/firmId/userId (RF-056, RF-092). Idempotency: safe read (GET). Pagination: none (bounded: one item per SummaryKind).

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120).

queryParams.description: Query parameters (exactly as documented; unknown parameters are rejected with 400).

from.description: Base version (version label issued by the Templates Service, not a uuid, e.g. 'v7').

to.description: Target version (version label issued by the Templates Service, not a uuid, e.g. 'v7').
